PHASE.NAME: Professional GRACE Framework Upgrade
PHASE.GOAL: Implement the grace-upgrade-guide roadmap as a persistent MyGRACE execution plan, starting with Sprint 1 P0 Foundation and continuing through all 13 feature sections without losing order across context compaction.

EXECUTION_POLICY.rule-1: Always resume from docs/plan-index.xml, then this Phase-13 shard, then the current section source guide.
EXECUTION_POLICY.rule-2: Implement sections strictly in roadmap order: Sprint 1 section-1 through section-4, Sprint 2 section-5 through section-8, Sprint 3 section-9 through section-11, Sprint 4 section-12 through section-13.
EXECUTION_POLICY.rule-3: For every new runtime module, add a source MODULE_CONTRACT, update docs/graph-index.xml, create docs/modules/M-*.xml, update docs/verification-index.xml, and create docs/verification/V-M-*.xml before or in the same patch.
EXECUTION_POLICY.rule-4: Each section must add focused tests before moving to the next section; after each sprint run cargo fmt, cargo test, cargo clippy, refresh, verify --ci, and review --mode full --ci.
EXECUTION_POLICY.rule-5: Keep legacy behavior compatible unless the guide explicitly makes a new check strict. Old LINKS and START/END anchors must keep working during migration.

step-1.TITLE: Typed LINKS Format Upgrade
step-1.INTENT: Introduce typed, directional semantic links while preserving old comma-separated LINKS as backward-compatible warnings.
step-1.IMPLEMENTATION: Extend M-GRACE-CONTRACT with TypedLink, LinkDirection, LinkType parsing; update GraphRAG relationship types and builder extraction; add links-valid-types, links-targets-exist, links-no-dangling, and links-format checks; extend graphrag_query type filters; update AGENTS.md.
step-1.VERIFY: Unit tests for new and old LINKS formats, invalid type, dangling target, GraphRAG typed relationships, and type-filtered query support.

step-2.TITLE: Log Driven Development Structured LOG Format
step-2.INTENT: Add structured LOG entries with EVENT, CONTEXT, STATE, DECISION, EXPECTATION, RESULT, and TRACEABILITY so runtime behavior can be semantically analyzed.
step-2.IMPLEMENTATION: Create grace log model/formatter; add structured-log-format verification; add analyze_logs MCP handler with trajectory, anomaly, and compare modes; document the new logging contract in AGENTS.md.
step-2.VERIFY: Tests for GraceLog emission/parsing, missing EXPECTATION detection, anomaly reports, analyze_logs MCP output, and structured-log-format verify/review checks.

step-3.TITLE: Observable AI Belief State
step-3.INTENT: Require explicit AI understanding, strategy, verification intent, and acknowledged risks before code generation.
step-3.IMPLEMENTATION: Create M-GRACE-BELIEF-STATE module, docs/belief-states directory support, parser/validator, belief-state-exists verify check, status/review coverage, and extract_belief_state MCP handler.
step-3.VERIFY: Tests for valid belief state parsing, missing required field validation, storage artifact generation, MCP storage path, skills/MCP count parity, and belief-state verify/review/status coverage.

step-4.TITLE: XML-like Anchor Syntax
step-4.INTENT: Support GRACE XML-like anchors alongside legacy START/END anchors through normalization and parser support.
step-4.IMPLEMENTATION: Extend semantic extractor and contract parser to recognize MODULE, BLOCK, METHOD, FUNCTION_CONTRACT, LOG, BELIEF_STATE, and LINKS XML-like anchors; add normalize_anchor_syntax; add anchor-syntax-consistent warning; update AGENTS.md.
step-4.VERIFY: Tests for XML-like blocks, nested anchors, XML-like function contracts, mixed syntax warning, normalization, and legacy regression.

step-5.TITLE: RequirementsAnalysis with AAG Notation
step-5.INTENT: Replace stub requirements with a complete requirements artifact model: goals, domain entities, actors, use cases, NFRs, constraints, and glossary.
step-5.IMPLEMENTATION: Create requirements parser/validator, full init template, generate_requirements MCP handler, requirements-* verify checks, and status/review coverage.
step-5.VERIFY: Tests for init template, generated complete requirements, incomplete section failures, AAG extraction, and glossary/entity matching.

step-6.TITLE: Technology Stack Version Pinning
step-6.INTENT: Make technology.xml exact, version-pinned, compatibility-aware, and detectable from project dependency files.
step-6.IMPLEMENTATION: Create technology parser, dependency detector, compatibility checks, full init template, generate_technology MCP handler, and technology-* verify checks.
step-6.VERIFY: Tests for Cargo detection, exact version validation, latest/blank rejection, known issues section, and incompatible matrix detection.

step-7.TITLE: DevelopmentPlan DataFlows and GenerationOrder
step-7.INTENT: Upgrade the plan artifact into a real generation blueprint with architecture graph, DataFlows, GenerationOrder, NonHumanPatterns, and contract guidelines.
step-7.IMPLEMENTATION: Create development_plan module, parse DataFlows and GenerationOrder in inventory_plan, add dataflow-* and genorder-* checks, add generate_development_plan MCP handler, and update grace_execute skill behavior.
step-7.VERIFY: Tests for valid plan, circular generation order, missing module refs, dataflow contract mismatch, and status phase progress.

step-8.TITLE: Mental Tests
step-8.INTENT: Add pre-code algorithm simulation and make failed mental tests block code generation for complex or critical modules.
step-8.IMPLEMENTATION: Create mental_test parser/executor, mental-test-defined, mental-tests-passed, and mental-test-no-drift checks; add mental_test_run MCP handler; integrate with plan, execute, review, status, and fix workflows.
step-8.VERIFY: Tests for pass/fail simulations, edge cases, missing mental tests for critical modules, and drift between expectations and implementation/logs.

step-9.TITLE: End-to-End Traceability
step-9.INTENT: Build bidirectional traceability from requirement and use case through module, function, code block, verification, and LOG entry.
step-9.IMPLEMENTATION: Create traceability module and docs/traceability-index.xml generator; add traceability_report MCP handler; add traceability-* verify checks and status/review score.
step-9.VERIFY: Tests for upward and downward trace, unimplemented requirement gap, untraced function gap, dangling trace link, and LOG traceability extraction.

step-10.TITLE: Non-Human Programming Patterns
step-10.INTENT: Enforce AI-deterministic coding patterns: explicit typing, explicit flow, explicit null handling, no magic values, and deterministic iteration.
step-10.IMPLEMENTATION: Create non_human_patterns checker with profile-aware severities; integrate verify, review, status, capabilities, and contract validation.
step-10.VERIFY: Tests for each anti-pattern, profile behavior lite/balanced/strict, clean examples, and real-module score reporting.

step-11.TITLE: Agent-Based Testing
step-11.INTENT: Add natural-language testing guides, tester-agent failure reports, and an embedded agent console for tool-based application testing.
step-11.IMPLEMENTATION: Create agent_console module, grace testing module, docs/tests layout, run_test_guide and submit_test_report MCP handlers, tester subagent skill updates, and AGENTS.md protocol documentation.
step-11.VERIFY: Tests for Markdown guide parsing, pass report, failure XML report with LOG evidence, console tool registration, and tester agent configuration output.

step-12.TITLE: Cascade Update Engine
step-12.INTENT: Detect downstream impact of artifact changes, preview cascades, apply safe contract updates, and record cascade changelogs.
step-12.IMPLEMENTATION: Create cascade and cascade_change modules, docs/cascade layout, cascade_impact and cascade_execute MCP handlers, cascade-no-drift verify check, and cascade-aware refresh/status/review.
step-12.VERIFY: Tests for requirement impact analysis, unrelated artifact no-op, preview chain formatting, changelog creation, and post-cascade drift detection.

step-13.TITLE: Belief State Dashboard
step-13.INTENT: Expose belief states, mental tests, traceability chains, cascade preview, and cascade history in the existing dashboard.
step-13.IMPLEMENTATION: Extend dashboard routes and JSON APIs for belief-states, mental-tests, traceability, cascade-impact, and cascade history using the new GRACE modules as data sources.
step-13.VERIFY: Tests or smoke checks for each route/API, JSON validity, module detail rendering, and data refresh after artifact changes.

GLOBAL_ACCEPTANCE.CHECK: syn verify reports the new checks: belief-state-exists, mental-tests-passed, non-human-*, structured-log-format, links-*, traceability-*, dataflow-*, genorder-*, cascade-no-drift, and anchor-syntax-consistent.
syn init generates complete requirements.xml, technology.xml, DevelopmentPlan-compatible sharded artifacts, graph-index.xml, and verification-index.xml.

MCP tools exist and are listed in capabilities: extract_belief_state, mental_test_run, analyze_logs, traceability_report, generate_requirements, generate_technology, generate_development_plan, cascade_impact, cascade_execute, run_test_guide, and submit_test_report.
Synapse self-verifies against the new checks without regressing legacy projects that use comma-separated LINKS or START/END anchors.
AGENTS.md, README/GUIDE where relevant, skills registry, and parity tests document the new behavior and do not mention obsolete monolithic artifacts as primary truth.
